test_title: PYST 228: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

U _ _ Q G _ X P _ _ UX _ _ G
solution:
Given : U _ _ Q G _ X P _ _ UX _ _ G

By checking options :

 
• XPUQGPQ → U __**X**__ __**P**__ Q G __**U**__ X P __**Q**__ __**G**__ UX __**P**__ __**Q**__ G → (It follows the pattern of : UXPQG - UXPQG - UXPQG)
 
• XQPGUPQ → U __X__ __P__ Q G __U__ X P __Q__ __G__ UX __P__ __Q__ G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• XPQUQGP → U __X__ __P__ Q G __U__ X P __Q__ __G__ UX __P__ __Q__ G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• QPXUGQP → U __X__ __P__ Q G __U__ X P __Q__ __G__ UX __P__ __Q__ G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of " U __X__ __P__ Q G - __U__ X P __Q__ __G__ - UX __P__ __Q__ G "

Hence, "**XPUQGPQ**" is the correct answer.
